title: Command Icon Tooltip And Rightclick Slot

specification.title: Command Icon Tooltip And Rightclick Slot
specification.goal: icon actions, tooltips and optional right-click command
specification.owner_rule: The named command is a GUI/command-line action only. Call the designated implementation owner; do not create a second geometry kernel or duplicate data stores.
specification.parent_scope: Main Menu, Icon History, panel arrangement Matrix
specification.parent_exclusions: Không dựng lại app docking kernel.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Command Icon Tooltip And Rightclick Slot” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M01: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Command Icon Tooltip And Rightclick Slot”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

execution_design.title: Command Icon Tooltip And Rightclick Slot
execution_design.goal_from_canonical: icon actions, tooltips and optional right-click command
execution_design.positive_oracle_proposed: Tooltip lists command name and optional rightclick alternative only if registered
execution_design.negative_oracle_proposed: Rightclick slot with no command must not execute previous action
execution_design.reuse_approval_condition: Audit local checkout at pinned SHA, compile/tests, M00 human legal approval; do not infer ready from static GitHub read.
execution_design.implementation_owner_policy: One owning L2, UI modules dispatch only. No source code changes in vendor-research/ unless approved fork.
objectives: Define typed seam + explicitly testable oracle
Implement one capability at its canonical owner
Verify failure rollback, stable IDs/units/geometry as relevant

runtime_implementation.scope: SVG command icons with tooltips; optional Feature.right_click slot is inert when absent and never repeats the primary action.

icon_readability.scope: Icon inset reduced from 3pt to 1.5pt (3pt larger painted square in the same slot), brighter enabled card/hover/outline, subtle top-edge highlight. Disabled cards retain a darker fill and non-invoking interaction.

auxiliary_palettes.scope: Restore the user-supplied Display/Snaps/Info & Settings icon counts, row order, group gaps and auxiliary control positions using existing authored vectors.
auxiliary_palettes.availability: All three palettes remain non-invoking presentation adapters with unavailable-operation tooltips. No geometry/backend capability enabled.

icon_size_audit.scope: Measure actual icon slots at default 360 logical-point dock across four client resolutions and three simulated scales. No runtime sizing or command behavior changed by this audit.

live_icon_resize.scope: Live icon resize on Windows maximize/restore while retaining reference palette counts, row order, ten-column Main Menu and 360-point default dock.
